records.question: What share of revenue comes from customers who ordered more than once?
records.raw:
WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
order_revenue AS (
  SELECT vo.order_id, vo.customer_unique_id, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
  FROM valid_orders vo
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = vo.order_id
  GROUP BY vo.order_id, vo.customer_unique_id
),
customer_order_counts AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
  FROM valid_orders
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
repeat_customers AS (
